records.title: Daughters of Tabor · Tabernacles
records.note: The 1891 Manual records Daughters, Tabernacles and offices including Chief Grand Preceptress and Chief Preceptress. This is an independent entry point into the women’s branch of the shared International Order of Twelve.
links: Scottish Rite Masonic Museum & Library · International Order of Twelve

records.title: Saba Meroe and women’s offices
records.note: The Manual records Saba Meroe, Daughters and women’s titles. Verify the full progression called Adoption, Advance and Sealed Daughter at the page and edition level before adopting it as a universal sequence.

records.title: 1891 · Daughters’ emblems and the Grand Queen Mother
records.note: The Manual illustrates crescent and other emblems bearing 333 before the Tabernacle installation ceremony. It also directly invokes Mount Tabor in the instructions to the Grand Queen Mother. This supports a biblical allusion in the order’s own rituals.

records.title: Mound Bayou · health and mutual aid
records.note: The state inventory attributes the hospital to the Knights and Daughters jointly. Chapter minutes, hospital boards, local histories and newspapers can establish the role of named women in specific decisions.
links: Mississippi Department of Archives & History · Taborian Hospital

records.title: Recover the Tabernacle-level record
records.note: Seek dated charters, proceedings, officer lists, membership rolls, local obituaries and benefit records. Capture names only as recorded and cite page, jurisdiction and repository.
